text: I can explain how SQS visibility timeouts, RabbitMQ acks and Kafka offset commits each decide when a message is redelivered.
I can say where to place the acknowledgement to get at-most-once or at-least-once, and draw the crash timeline for each.
I can name a workload where at-most-once is the right choice and justify it.
I can explain why exactly-once delivery is impossible and build an effectively-once consumer with a dedup table in the same transaction as the effect.
I can describe what Kafka's idempotent producer and transactions guarantee, and what they don't.
